messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1 — Stormhaven Bank (tenant stormhaven-88) VPC export produced unredacted logs. Impact: potential PII exposure in retained exports. Pager routed to oncall SRE. Link: https://redwood.incidents/1951234567
sam (sre-oncall): I'm on. Quick ask — has export already finished or is it streaming? Need to stop any running jobs and snapshot the pool.
maria (oncall-sre): I can take the intervention. Which pool is affected? Confirming dedicated pool id `pool-8b3` per customer metadata.
josh (support-eng): Confirmed from customer console: export job `export-2026-03-15-09` started at 09:12, status `complete`. They requested full logs for downstream forensics. They attached a truncated sample — see below.
josh (support-eng): ```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z INFO export:start tenant=stormhaven-88 job=export-2026-03-15-09 path=s3://st-haven-exports/2026/03/15/logs.ndjson
2026-03-15T09:12:17Z WARN log:redaction-miss tenant=stormhaven-88 event_id=0a1b user_email=jane.doe@stormhaven.com
2026-03-15T09:12:18Z INFO export:finished tenant=stormhaven-88 bytes=18,342,211
```
josh (support-eng): The `log:redaction-miss` lines look like unredacted PII. Customer says they need the export for legal team but also asked us to redact—conflict.
elaine (security): :eyes: This is sensitive. We need a formal redaction-exception + legal hold before allowing retention beyond policy. Do NOT provide raw file to anyone outside legal/CS. Create forensic snapshot and lock the S3 export bucket.
leah (customer-success): Customer (Stormhaven legal) just DM'd me asking for expedited retention — they're opening a compliance review. They want us to keep the export intact and share with their counsel. They also asked if we can do a redaction-lite to remove emails before sharing.
sam (sre-oncall): Steps I'm going to run now:
1) isolate dedicated pool `pool-8b3` (no new requests)
2) snapshot current KV/cache and take flux snapshot
3) set export bucket to `readonly` and set object lock
Commands I'm running:
```
# isolate pool
redwoodctl pool scale --pool pool-8b3 --min 0 --max 0 --drain
# create snapshot
redwoodctl snapshot create --pool pool-8b3 --tag incident-1951234567
# lock s3 bucket
aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket st-haven-exports --versioning-configuration Status=Enabled
aws s3api put-object-retention --bucket st-haven-exports --key 2026/03/15/logs.ndjson --retention '{"Mode":"GOVERNANCE","RetainUntilDate":"2036-03-15T00:00:00"}'
```
maria (oncall-sre): I've kicked the drain. Pool shows `draining` and no new allocations. Snapshot started, ETA ~ 90s. Copying snapshot to secure bucket `redwood-incidents-archive/1951234567` with restricted KMS key.
elaine (security): Send me the snapshot ARN and the KMS key id. Legal needs to approve any decryption/handout. Also need an exception ticket (retention/redaction) logged.
legal-bot: Suggested retention-exception template:
```
- Customer: Stormhaven Bank (tenant stormhaven-88)
- Incident: 1951234567
- Reason: legal/forensic review; customer requested unredacted export
- Proposed action: retain original export under customer-specific KMS, restrict access to legal and CS, perform redacted copy for product teams
- Duration: until legal clearance; request 90 days default
- Approver: Legal counsel (name & signature required)
```
leah (customer-success): I've requested written approval from Stormhaven legal and cc'd Redwood Legal. They replied they will DM signed approval to our legal contact in ~2hrs. They explicitly asked if we can run a deterministic redaction to obfuscate emails before we hand anything to product teams.
sam (sre-oncall): Agreed: we will not share the original file outside legal/CS. For internal debugging we can work with redacted extracts. Security — what's our suggested redaction approach here? Full PII scrubbing vs tokenization?
elaine (security): For production forensic work, prefer tokenization (deterministic) so links between events are preserved for investigators, but that still counts as controlled data. For anything leaving our environment, require legal sign-off. We can run a redaction job with `--deterministic` flag.
sam (sre-oncall): Plan: take snapshot, copy to incident bucket with KMS key, run redaction tool with `--deterministic` to produce `logs.redacted.ndjson`, keep original under legal lock. Only CS+Legal have read on original. Product/eng get sanitized redacted file. Documenting chain-of-custody here.
maria (oncall-sre): Snapshot complete. Copy to `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-incidents-archive/1951234567/logs.orig.ndjson` encrypted with KMS `arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-195123`. Setting ACL to legal+cs.
leah (customer-success): Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please include a timestamped audit trail of every action for the customer's compliance team.
sam (sre-oncall): Logged actions to incident ticket and audit. Added these entries:
- 1951234567.1 snapshot created pool-8b3
- 1951234567.2 bucket locked & retention applied
- 1951234567.3 copy to incidents-archive created
- 1951234567.4 redaction job queued (pending legal approval)
elaine (security): Also capture who decrypted/queried the snapshot — require MFA for any decryption ops. I will create a temp policy limiting access to `legal@redwood` and `leah@redwood`.
legal-bot: For approval workflow: Redwood legal must receive signed customer request + internal justification. If both present, Legal will approve redaction-exception and sign retention waiver. Template: attach signed PDF and include approver name.
leah (customer-success): Stormhaven legal says they'll send signed request within 90 minutes and asked for confirmation once retention + lock are in place.
sam (sre-oncall): Done — notified customer that we have snapshot + lock in place and will not release original until legal sign-off. Queued redaction job but not running.
maria (oncall-sre): Handoff: I need to go OOO in 40 mins. Sam — you're covering the incident. Please escalate to overnight oncall if legal approval doesn't arrive by 23:00 UTC.
sam (sre-oncall): Acknowledged. I'll keep watch and follow legal approval. If no signed approval by 23:00 UTC, escalate to night oncall @maria-noc.
elaine (security): I'll monitor access logs and set alert if any access attempt to original file is made by non-approved principals.
leah (customer-success): I'll update Stormhaven with the snapshot ARN and confirm we won't share raw file until legal sign-off. Thanks all.
sam (sre-oncall): Closing actions for now: isolation done, snapshot + copy done, retention lock applied, redaction job queued pending legal. Will update thread when legal sign-off or next step.
incident-bot: Incident 1951234567 — state changed to `mitigated` (actions taken: snapshot, bucket lock, queued redaction). Oncall owner: sam (sre-oncall). Next update expected within 2 hours. :thumbsup:"
